name: Reset Kibana state:storeInSessionStorage
description: Choose deployments and whether to preview (dry-run) or apply (execute).

spec.question_description: Deployment names separated by commas, spaces or new lines (e.g. cdm-va, cdm-fed), or all for every deployment in deployments.txt. all cannot be combined with names.
dry-run reports what would change and changes nothing. execute changes the setting.
set-false writes an explicit false (visible in Advanced Settings). reset-to-default removes the override, like the UI's Reset to default. Both leave the setting false.
Kibana space IDs to limit the run to, separated by commas or spaces (e.g. default, master). Leave blank for every space.
Kibana space IDs to leave alone, separated by commas or spaces. Leave blank to skip none.
How many copies of the script run on the appserver at once. Deployments are split evenly between them.
Keep true. false skips certificate checks for Kibana (last resort).
true logs every Kibana API request (URLs only, never credentials).
